<description>
Updates the I2P SAM leaseset parameters to `6,4` (MLKEM-768/ECIES-X25519), as is [now recommended](https://i2p.net/en/docs/api/samv3/#signature-and-encryption-types) by the I2P project. ElGamal leasesets are now considered "legacy" and likely should not be used anymore.
</description>

ACK 412540e

Isolating (>1yr from now) `onlynet=i2p` <v27 nodes is not ideal, but based on the comments above they are already isolated on the I2P network. So they are already relatively cheap to attack the privacy of and/or eclipse, so they lose little by this change.
